sections.html: The 2nd group contains regular verbs ending in -ir whose nous form ends in -issons. About 300 verbs, all conjugated the same way.

sections.heading: How to conjugate
sections.html:
Remove -ir → stem, then add:

Pronoun Ending finir (to finish) choisir (to choose)
je -is je finis je choisis
tu -is tu finis tu choisis
il / elle / on -it il finit elle choisit
nous -issons nous finissons nous choisissons
vous -issez vous finissez vous choisissez
ils / elles -issent ils finissent elles choisissent

Pronunciation: finis, finis, finit sound the same ("fee-nee"). In the plural, you hear the -iss- sound: ils finissent ("fee-neess").

sections.heading: Common 2nd group verbs
sections.html:
Verb Meaning Verb Meaning
finir to finish réussir to succeed / pass
choisir to choose réfléchir (à) to think (about)
grandir to grow up grossir to gain weight
maigrir to lose weight rougir to blush
obéir (à) to obey punir to punish
remplir to fill applaudir to applaud
bâtir to build vieillir to get old

Tip: many verbs formed from adjectives are 2nd group: grand → grandir, rouge → rougir, maigre → maigrir, vieux → vieillir.

sections.heading: How to tell 2nd group from 3rd group -ir verbs
sections.html: Not every -ir verb is 2nd group. Partir, dormir, sortir, venir, ouvrir are 3rd group (no -iss-): nous partons, not ~~partissons~~. When in doubt, check if the nous form has -issons.

sections.heading: Examples
sections.html:
• Je finis le travail à 17 heures. — I finish work at 5 pm.
  • Les enfants grandissent vite ! — Children grow up fast!
  • Vous choisissez le menu ? — Are you choosing the set menu?
  • Il réussit toujours ses examens. — He always passes his exams.

exercises.answer: je réussis, tu réussis, il réussit, nous réussissons, vous réussissez, ils réussissent.

exercises.prompt: Fill in: (a) Nous ___ (choisir) un film. (b) Tu ___ (réfléchir) trop ! (c) Elles ___ (remplir) les verres. (d) Il ___ (rougir) facilement.
Is *dormir* a 2nd group verb? How do you know?
exercises.answer: No. Its *nous* form is *dormons*, not ~~dormissons~~, so it is 3rd group.
